technical_architecture: Logical services in one FastAPI application; provider commits are independent of SQL.
SPA; WhatsApp; merchant gateways|Role-aware forms and conversations
Auth/JWT; signed WhatsApp queue|Tenant binding; audited assistance
Routers; lifespan; shared clients|Pydantic validation; async pools
Supervisor; typed workers; budgets|Grounded advice; no wallet authority
Rating; booking; finance; returns|Customs; claims; dispatch; tracking
Carriers; Stripe; PAF; Auth; Twilio|Stores; insurer; CRM; tariff; OpenAI
Versioned guide chunks and citations|Lexical / local 256D vector retrieval
Tenant predicates; RLS; row locks|Snapshots; ledger; receipts; audit
Ordered WhatsApp; SQL outboxes|Polling; realtime; reconciliation
functional_architecture: Business and individual workspaces share one shipping and financial lifecycle.
Business or personal profile|Website / WhatsApp identity proof
Team; addresses; contacts; products|Return warehouse; carrier access
Manual; CSV; stores; marketplace|References and actionable row errors
Measured boxes; goods allocation|Real addresses; customs review
Business rules or individual markup|Deterministic top ten; optional badge
Price; expiry; role; connection|No model authorizes purchase
Workspace reservation or Stripe|Verified events; exact total/currency
Native label confirmation; capture|PDF/forms; unknown outcomes retained
Milestones; exceptions; eligible POD|Store and support outboxes
Return warehouse; fresh quote|Retailer/customer pay; real QR or print
Invoice disputes; eligible claims|Evidence; verified settlement
Cohort reports; margins; support|Audited client assistance
agent_architecture: Typed optional model output proposes facts or advice; native code owns actions.
Web chat; signed WhatsApp|Real user context; stable message IDs
Typed intents; private turn drafts|Explicit action grammar; role checks
Quote; book; track; top-up|Claim intake; full-parcel return
Quote/conversation facts; CSV headers|No invented facts, identifiers or units
Workflow state; bounded delegation|Runtime: one turn; strict outputs
Reviewed catalog / supplied candidates|Official tariff ranker; human review
Published guide retrieval / citations|Lexical fallback; optional embeddings
Immutable priced shortlist|Budget eligibility; optional badge
Exact invoice audit; native support|Deterministic delegates; no LLM call
booking_lifecycle: A reserved hold, submitted mutation, captured charge and refund are distinct.
Tenant; role; goods; exact total|Current expiry and connection snapshot
Approved connection; test/live mode|Ready customs; bookability; funding
Advisory lock and idempotency key|Immutable selected price snapshot
Wallet/billing row lock|Atomic reservation and ledger state
Write-ahead mutation fence|Never blindly duplicate a purchase
Buy once; retain provider reference|Later retrieval uses GET only
Persist label/tracking; capture once|Queue appropriate store tracking
Native financial release|New quote before a new purchase
Retain reserved credit/reference|GET/poll/review; no blind retry
returns_lifecycle: One return controller retains original shipment, tenant and store identity.
Tenant; actor; source; input digest|One full-parcel return; replay observes
Original customer becomes origin|Active RETURN address/version is checked
Current approved connections|Lowest exact price; budget wins ties
Retailer: native workspace billing|Customer: owner/admin Stripe link
No label before verified customer pay|Existing locks and financial settlement
Sendcloud labelless / USPS form|Real provider asset; scoped share link
No universal QR or location promise|Selected carrier eligible locations
Status / GET recovery; no repurchase|Separate store return tracking
onboarding_lifecycle: Deterministic state machine; identity proof precedes workspace activation.
Unbound sender opts into signup|Scoped receipt and delivery fence
Company and registration number|Required business profile facts
Skip corporate metadata|Personal name after proof
Identity collision checks|Supabase issues email OTP
Six-digit code stored as HMAC|Expiry; resend and attempt budget
EMAIL_CODE then PHONE_CODE in chat|Email accepts 6-10 digits; phone six
Auth binding plus SQL transaction|Tenant; OWNER; zero GBP wallet
Auth single-use recovery email|Allowlisted app origin; normal login
